1824239290/OcPlayer.body:
# OcPlayer · Orange Cat Player

A native player for Jellyfin / Emby, built with SwiftUI for both platforms (primarily macOS, with iOS / iPadOS from the same codebase). The playback core is [liberika](https://github.com/AimesSoft/liberika), written in Rust (formerly Erika, with built-in FFmpeg decoding and libass subtitle rendering). Danmaku (bullet comment) support connects to dandanplay, and the app also integrates Bangumi anime tracking and MoviePilot for finding, downloading, and subscribing to titles.

## Features

- **Media library** — Automatically detects Jellyfin / Emby. Multiple servers are remembered and can be switched with one click. A server can have several addresses (LAN / Tailscale / reverse-proxy domain), and the app automatically picks the fastest reachable one and switches to another if it becomes unreachable. Library sorting, watch-status filtering, and full-library search. Home page with Continue Watching, Up Next, and Recently Added. Detail pages show complete media info (resolution, codec, bitrate, with audio and subtitle tracks listed individually) and a poster-based ambient background.
- **Playback** — Hardware decoding. ArtCNN image enhancement (optional, 2× brightness reconstruction). HDR / Dolby Vision output matched to screen capability. Playback speed, audio and subtitle track switching, external subtitles (deletable), subtitle appearance (position / color / outline / bold), chapter jumping, resume, and auto-play next. Playback progress is reported to the server so you can continue on another device. Automatic intro/outro detection with a floating Skip button, combining several sources (community annotations, danmaku timing reports, chapters, etc.). Native Liquid Glass HUD, with keyboard shortcuts on macOS.
- **Danmaku** — Works out of the box with a built-in public gateway, so it works as soon as you connect. If no match is found, you can search manually, select the episode, and adjust the time offset. Opacity, display area, and types can be adjusted at any time.
- **Bangumi tracking** — After logging in, syncs your collections and in-progress watching, and lets you browse the daily broadcast calendar. An episode is automatically marked as watched when you finish it.
- **MoviePilot search** — Search site resources by title, start downloads, and manage subscriptions. Finished downloads automatically appear in the library.
- **Config backup and multi-device sync** — Export your TMDB key, playback preferences, and danmaku settings as a single JSON file. Save it to iCloud Drive or send it to another device via AirDrop, then restore with one click. Server passwords and other credentials are not included in the backup.
- **Local playback** — ⌘O to open local files or direct links.

If you don't use Bangumi or MoviePilot, you can disable them in Settings, and all their entry points will be hidden.

## System Requirements

- macOS 26 or later (Apple Silicon)
- iOS 26 or later (iPhone / iPad)
- Servers: Jellyfin 10.x / 12.x, Emby 4.x

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

guaner-334/civ-atlas.description: Generate a complete planet in the browser and simulate its history, producing an editable map and chronicle. Aimed at original worldbuilding for novels, setting bibles, and tabletop RPGs.
guaner-334/civ-atlas.body:
Generate a complete planet in the browser and simulate its history: use plate tectonics, river erosion, climate, and ocean currents to compute terrain and ecology, then simulate peoples, states, wars, and dynastic succession, producing an editable map and chronicle. Aimed at original worldbuilding for novels, setting bibles, and tabletop RPGs.

**[Use online](https://atlas.gerdor.top)** | [Roadmap](#路线图) | [Development notes](https://github.com/guaner-334/civ-atlas/blob/HEAD/docs/development.md) | [Report issues](https://github.com/guaner-334/civ-atlas/issues) | [QQ discussion group 925687934](#反馈与参与)

The website is free to use. Generation, simulation, editing, saving, and exporting all happen in the browser; no installation or registration is required. Within the same version, the same seed and parameters produce a bit-for-bit identical world on any device; save files record only the seed, parameters, and edits, and are usually just a few KB.

## Features

### Planet generation

- **Spherical mesh**: spherical Poisson-disk sampling plus spherical Delaunay triangulation, about 36,000 irregular cells by default, adjustable up to 200,000. The map wraps east-west, includes both poles, and has no planar seams.
- **Plate tectonics**: plates of widely varying size move around Euler poles; convergent zones build mountains, subduction zones form trenches, and divergent zones form mid-ocean ridges. Produces continents, microcontinents, island arcs, and polar continents.
- **River erosion**: stream power law, solved with the implicit method of Braun & Willett (2013); Priority-Flood fills depressions, and river networks and lakes are derived from drainage calculations.
- **Climate**: temperature is computed from latitude and elevation; the three-cell circulation's wind belts carry moisture downwind, windward slopes get more rain, and leeward slopes form rain shadows.
- **Ocean currents**: warm currents, cold currents, and coastal upwelling are placed according to large-scale ocean circulation patterns, altering coastal temperature and precipitation.
- **Biomes**: divided into rainforest, grassland, desert, tundra, etc., by mean annual temperature and annual precipitation (Whittaker diagram).

### Historical simulation

- **Peoples and states**: peoples spread from their origin across habitable land, blocked by mountains, oceans, and deserts; they found cities, establish states, expand, fight wars and make peace, pay tribute as vassals, form and break alliances, split, merge, restore themselves, and move capitals. States short of salt, horses, iron, or gold will go to war over provinces across the border that have these resources.
- **Order and decline**: regions suffer famine, peasant uprisings, and plague (plague zones are drawn on the map); a great power that dominates a continent declines after its peak, then fragments and is reunified.
- **Court and provinces**: the central government assigns each province direct rule, delegated administration, autonomy, or breakaway status; garrison commanders may become semi-independent and defy orders, and the court can also reclaim control. The 'administration' fill color shows how much of each province is under control.
- **Dynasties and figures**: dynastic change and genealogies; each monarch and general has a biography (reign years, father and sons, predecessor and successor, personal campaigns, fate), and each dynasty has a family tree. Each dynasty also has several eminent ministers who, like generals, have courtesy names, places of origin, offices, and a life story; their negotiations, regency, and enthronements are recorded in the chronicle.

huangziyuan-general/dsh-novel-forge.description: AI writing long novels fails in four ways: the setting collapses, earlier text is forgotten, padding inflates the word count, and pages fill with AI-sounding prose. This plugin blocks all four in code. No chapter gets written until its detailed outline is approved, changes to a set value are rejected outright, repeated sentences and paragraphs are caught by automated review, and the six-dimension de-AI-flavor scan uses zero tokens. The right-sidebar Forge panel offers read-aloud, whole-book health checks, and batch drafting with resumable breakpoints. It provides 20 novel_* tools. You just tell the story, and code handles the gatekeeping. Novel-writing guardrails plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
huangziyuan-general/dsh-novel-forge.body:
# dsh-novel-forge · Novel Forge > Chinese docs | [English](https://github.com/huangziyuan-general/dsh-novel-forge/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) [](https://github.com/huangziyuan-general/dsh-novel-forge/actions/workflows/ci.yml) A Chinese-language long-form novel writing plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It is not a 'prompt collection'. Instead, it builds **consistency, gating, and auditing** into the tool layer and data layer: the model handles drafting, while the plugin blocks anything broken, distorted, or overflowing before it is written to disk. **Who it's for:** Long-form authors with multiple characters, multiple volumes, or serials of dozens or hundreds of chapters, who get stuck on 'the setting collapsed', 'forgot earlier text', 'suspense spoiled', or 'too much AI flavor'. **One-line pitch:** All key constraints are coded: changing a value within the same chapter is rejected as a conflict, hidden characters never enter the context, an outline missing a scene gets the draft rejected, old versions are never overwritten, and long-text retrieval runs locally with zero dependencies. [Quick start](#快速开始约-5-分钟) | [UI overview](#界面一览) | [Hard constraints table](#ai-写作通病与硬约束) | [23 tools](#23-个工具) ## Why not just another 'prompt collection' Most writing plugins put their constraints in the system prompt. The model follows them when it's in a good mood and works around them when rushed. This plugin's design rests on one principle: > **Code enforcement > prompt-based self-discipline.** Any constraint that relies on the model behaving well will eventually fail. Consistency, gating, and auditing must be hard constraints at the tool and data layers. Three facts you can verify against the source code in the repo: 1. **All three entry points share one judgment chain:** the panel's "💾 Save", `novel_write_chapter`, and REST writes all go through the same gating code (automated review / ledger conflicts / content gate / outline contract). There is no bypass. The only release switch explicitly records an audit entry. 2. **The model cannot self-approve proposals:** the revision-proposal model can only register proposals, not apply them. "Apply" is the user's action in the panel, since there is no apply tool on the model side. Outline approvals record the approval channel, and the dashboard tracks the "tool self-approval ratio". In a real-world test, one serial had 168 of 168 approvals self-approved, which was the first gap leading to outline drift. 3. **Auditing costs zero tokens:** automated review, de-AI-flavor scanning, platform review, consistency checks, and ledger timeline inference are all pure local computation. Per-chapter audit cost is 0, and no numbers pass through the model. ## UI overview Screenshots of the right-sidebar 'Forge' panel, rendered on a real install (all of the following is **fictional sample data**, not real titles): | | | | --- | --- | | **Project list**

# All-Japan-Grid

**A map of electricity that no one owns.**
An open model of Japan's national transmission grid, built automatically from OpenStreetMap transmission lines and substations and checked against what the utilities publish. It solves power flow, draws every substation and lets you test disaster scenarios. Every modelling assumption is listed in the intervention registry.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | **https://lutelute.github.io/All-Japan-Grid/** — Entry point to all tools / every tool on one page |
| Grid map | https://lutelute.github.io/All-Japan-Grid/map.html |
| Flow map | https://lutelute.github.io/All-Japan-Grid/flow_map.html |
| Substation single-line diagram / SubSLD | https://lutelute.github.io/All-Japan-Grid/subsld.html |
| Download | https://lutelute.github.io/All-Japan-Grid/download.html |

**Scale** — Extracted from OSM: 40,087 transmission lines, 6,962 substations, and 19,138 power plants across 10 regions. The canonical model used for power flow calculations (`docs/data/built/`) has 17,744 nodes and 19,909 branches. 49 assumptions added to the model are recorded in the intervention registry. Release v1.9.0, distribution dataset v1.9.0.

molimao/iota.description: Open-source, five-language mining dashboard for IOTA Train at Home, PRL, BNT, XMR, ERG, ZEPH and more: saved addresses, worker status, available rewards and optional Mac agent controls.
molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

sdnwls/nai-style-lab.description: A Windows app that finds and refines your own art style by combining NovelAI artist tags
sdnwls/nai-style-lab.body:
# NAI Style Lab

An app that creates NovelAI artist tag combinations and finds and refines your own art style simply by choosing whichever of two options you prefer.

## Running

Double-click `run.bat` to open the window. When you close the window, your data is saved and the app exits automatically.
If you close the window while an image is being generated, the in-progress generation stops without waiting. The one result already sent to NovelAI is not received and is discarded, but everything created up to that point is saved.

- Data: `data/` (state.json, the previous backup state.json.bak kept from each run, images/, api_key.txt, thumbnail cache thumbs/)
- Error log: `data/app.log`

### Versions and Updates

Each time the app starts, it checks once for a new version on GitHub Releases. If one is available, a notice appears in the sidebar. Installing from Settings → Data → Update downloads the new version, closes the app, and reopens it as the new version.

- The `data/` folder is not touched during updates.
- File replacement happens after the app closes, and it either fully succeeds or fully fails. If it fails midway, the previous files are restored and the previous version is reopened.
- Downloaded files are installed only after their size and checksum (SHA-256, as provided by GitHub) are verified.
- If an update changes the data format, the new version saves the original file as `state.schemaN-date.json` on its first run and converts it. Older versions cannot open data saved by a newer version.
- In the source folder (the folder containing `_dev`), the app only checks for updates and does not install them.

## Workflow

The step indicator at the top of the screen and the **What to do now** button always show the next action.

| Step | What it does | Screen |
|---|---|---|
| ① Preparation | Enter API key, register artists, create random combinations | Settings · Artists · Create combinations |
| ② Ranking | New combinations find their place among existing ranking entries via binary search. During a batch, the Elo of existing combinations does not fluctuate. | Matchup |
| ③ Evolution | Blends and mutates the artists and weights of the current top 30% (S·A) combinations to create new ones, and uses matchups to find where they fall within the top 30%. If a new combination loses even to the lowest-ranked one in that group, it is eliminated; if it wins, it survives and the same number of existing lowest-ranked combinations are removed.…

tiqian-cjk/tiqian.description: 提椠 Tíqiàn is a CJK paragraph composer.
tiqian-cjk/tiqian.body:
Tíqiàn is a CJK paragraph composer.

On top of the font and rendering capabilities of each platform, it uniformly handles font selection, line breaking, line-start and line-end prohibitions (kinsoku), punctuation spacing, justification, inline space distribution, and interlinear annotations in Chinese body text.

## Current status

Tíqiàn is still in early development. No stable release has been published yet, and the public API and module structure may continue to change.

- [x] Simplified Chinese horizontal layout
- [ ] Traditional Chinese horizontal layout
  - [x] Zhuyin (Bopomofo) annotation
- [ ] Simplified / Traditional vertical layout
- [ ] Japanese typesetting (JLREQ)
- [ ] Korean typesetting (KLREQ)

Tíqiàn can currently be used through three front ends: Compose, Android View, and Web.

## Compose

The Compose front end supports Compose Desktop and Android 6.0 (API 23) and above:

```kotlin
implementation("org.tiqian:tiqian-compose:<version>")

// Projects using Material 3 can instead depend on tiqian-compose-material3 to read `LocalTextStyle`, `LocalContentColor`, and so on
implementation("org.tiqian:tiqian-compose-material3:<version>")
```

For plain text, you can directly replace Compose's `Text` with `CjkText`; existing `AnnotatedString` and `TextStyle` can also continue to be used.

```kotlin
val paragraph = buildAnnotatedString {
    append("编号 A-17 的青铜")
    ruby("盉", "hé")
    append("仍")
    emphasis { append("一并保留") }
    append("。")
}

CjkText(
    text = paragraph,
    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
)
```

`CjkText` preserves source line breaks and supports common rich text styles, interlinear annotations, and links. When integrating with an existing rich text renderer, you can use `cjkTextCompatibility()` to check which features are not yet faithfully supported. For read-only body text, you can wrap one or more `CjkText` in `CjkSelectionContainer`, which supports selecting and copying.

Full Markdown body text can use [Tíqiàn Markdown](https://github.com/tiqian-cjk/tiqian-markdown), which is built on Tíqiàn. On top of paragraph typesetting, it can also uniformly handle code, tables, formulas, images, footnotes, and more.

xiaour/yolo-data.description: Advanced and stable enterprise-grade intelligent analytics platform; a Data Agent for enterprise data Q&A and insight analysis, built on data analysis methodology to deliver auditable, governable, and reproducible workflows
xiaour/yolo-data.body:
[English](https://github.com/xiaour/yolo-data/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md) | Simplified Chinese

# YOLO Data Agent｜Enterprise Intelligent Data Q&A and Analytics Platform

YOLO Data Agent is for teams that need to unify business definitions, control data permissions, and retain analytical evidence. Users can ask questions in natural language, follow up, break down problems, and analyze directly. Administrators configure business subjects, metrics, datasets, models, Skills, and permission boundaries.

The platform does not treat “the large model generated a piece of SQL” as a reliable answer. The model is responsible for understanding questions, proposing plans, and explaining results. YOLO confirms context, compiles the query contract, enforces permissions, generates read-only queries, locks results, and saves evidence.

## Design Goals

- **Make business questions executable**: convert natural language into explicit metrics, dimensions, time, filters, sorting, and analysis goals.
- **Make query definitions governable**: business terms, metric definitions, field roles, enumerated value domains, and default rules are configured by the platform rather than guessed by the model on the fly.
- **Make data access controllable**: subjects, metrics, datasets, and row/column permissions are enforced server-side and cannot be bypassed through prompts.
- **Make results reviewable**: save query contracts, execution plans, result fingerprints, data hashes, workspace artifacts, and audit records.
- **Keep simple questions fast and let complex ones be decomposed**: each turn independently decides its execution path, and the whole session is not locked into a single computation mode.

## Core Design Principles

### 1. The YOLO session is the only source of truth for context

Session messages, task state, inherited conditions, clarification results, permissions, and workspace artifacts are managed uniformly by YOLO. Each execution turn forms versioned context. No model or planning thread may decide on its own whether to inherit the previous turn's metrics, time, or filters.

This allows follow-ups such as “break it down by province”, “switch to this year”, or “only East China” to continue based on explicit task state, rather than on the model guessing from chat history.

### 2. Contract-first: form the contract before accessing data

The model submits only structured query intent. The platform compiles it into a query contract and validates it before execution:

- Whether metrics, dimensions, and fields exist and are enabled;
- Whether the time range and aggregation granularity are explicit;
- Whether enumerated values and business rules have traceable sources;
- Whether the current user has permissions for the subject, dataset, rows, and columns;
- Whether the query meets read-only, row-limit, and stable-sorting requirements.

If the contract fails validation, no data query is executed, and no answer is assembled from similar fields.

### 3. The model proposes, the platform decides

The model is suited to semantic understanding, task planning, choice of analytical method, and business expression. Time calculation, permission merging, field allowlists, SQL compilation, numeric computation, and result validation are done by deterministic code. All numbers must come from successfully executed and locked data results.

### 4. Per-turn routing rather than session-level mode binding

Simple data queries prefer a low-latency deterministic path. Complex comparison, attribution, diagnosis, reporting, and code analysis enter a multi-step planning path. Routing is re-evaluated each turn. An existing planning thread does not force subsequent simple questions onto the complex path, and quick queries that occur in between are incorporated as canonical context at the next complex analysis.
